review_candidates.title: Software & DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will design, develop, and deliver scalable software solutions while simultaneously building, automating, and maintaining the CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure that support them. Key Responsibilities Software Development & Architecture Design and develop scalable, optimized software solutions tailored to internal and external customer needs. Infrastructure & Deployment Automation Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines utilizing tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps
eligibility_evidence: This hybrid role bridges the gap between traditional software development and modern infrastructure management.
What We Offer Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Your expertise will accelerate our software delivery lifecycle, enhance system reliability, and ensure robust security practices from code commit to production deployment. About You Qualifications & Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 3+ years of strong, hands-on experience blending Software Development and DevOps. Core Technical Skills Software Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python and the Django framework is a must. DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipeline development. Systems & Scripting: Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, PowerShell) Data & Integration: Expertise in relational databases (Microsoft SQL, MySQL), API development, and version control systems (Git).
